title: Create an editable, rigged avatar from this previously generated Muse-style pand

request.prompt: Create an editable, rigged avatar from this previously generated Muse-style panda and its small green shoulder dragon. Preserve the selected source character, proportions, black eye patches, black-and-ivory palette, and companion. Keep the dragon perched and attached to the shoulder during this run; do not separate it or make it fly. Do not add props, clothing, text, a pedestal or scenery.
request.style: Match the accepted reference portrait: soft, neatly groomed short fur on the panda, clear expressive eyes, tidy color boundaries and a rounded plush appearance. Keep the green dragon distinct and preserve its surface details; do not cover it in panda fur. Avoid a shiny plastic look.
custom_actions: A cheerful four-second toy dance with three alternating side-to-side beats, small whole-body hops, coordinated arm swings and gentle head tilts. Keep the shoulder dragon perched. Finish in the starting pose. This is authored toy motion, not physical balance or contact simulation.

authorization.reason: Explicit source reuse requires no new Meshy credits; existing bounded agent/local execution still applies.

warnings: Dance/hops are authored keyframed motion only; no physical balance, foot-ground contact solving, or impact dynamics are implied.
Keeping the dragon perched is treated as a rigid attachment to the shoulder region during animation; no independent dragon flight or separation is authored in this run.
Exact one-to-one reconstruction of the reference image geometry is not guaranteed; the prompt specifies intended appearance for generation/texture.
